name: Shiren Fuyune
source:
A girl who's always cracking silly jokes.

She has a disposition that isn't fazed by anything.
She sometimes puts on a weak or timid front, but most of the time it's an act—
she does it on purpose to lighten everyone's mood and put their hearts at ease.

On the other hand, she's oblivious to her own emotional pain,
and by the time she notices it, things have already become serious.

She's also well-versed in literature—for instance, she lectures Kozakura on the proper order to read the Sherlock Holmes series.
